key_insight: ECGLight is a compute-efficient framework that helps digitize paper ECGs and screen for myocardial infarction in low-resource settings. It aims to make AI-assisted ECG analysis usable even where internet access and hardware are limited.
problem_solved: Many clinics, especially in remote or underserved areas, still rely on paper ECG printouts that cannot be easily analyzed by modern AI systems because those systems often need strong connectivity and significant compute resources.
method: Converts paper ECG printouts into a digital format suitable for AI analysis.
Uses a lightweight framework designed to run with limited computational capacity.
Supports myocardial infarction screening directly from digitized ECG records in resource-constrained environments.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this shows how model and system design can be adapted for real-world deployment beyond data-rich hospitals. It highlights a practical path to bring decision support to low-resource clinical settings without requiring heavy infrastructure.

paper_title: ECGLight: Compute-Light Framework For Paper ECG Digitization and Myocardial Infarction Screening
paper_authors: Shreyasvi Natraj, Cyrus Achtari, Felice Gragnano, Andrea Milzi, Marco Valgimigli
